recent_en: TT Vision recently secured two orders for automated optical inspection equipment worth RM15.32 million and RM3.62 million, and a RM92 million contract. The company also announced an extension of the capital contribution completion date for its joint venture with Autowell to 10 September 2027. The latest quarterly results show a sharp decline in revenue and a widened loss.
notable_en: Secured a RM15.32 million purchase order for automated optical inspection equipment
Secured a RM3.62 million order from a global semiconductor maker
risks_en: Latest quarterly net loss of RM5.232 million, wider than the previous quarter
Prudential PLC ceased to be a substantial shareholder on 2 September 2026
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM1.686 million, down 64.7% QoQ and 87.5% YoY; net loss was RM5.232 million with a net margin of -310.3%, wider than -69.3% in the previous quarter.
